name: boq-pro
description: Professional BOQ, Estimation & Material Takeoff for Pakistan Construction

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @boq/web" "npm run start:dev -w @boq/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @boq/shared && npm run build -w @boq/engine && npm run build -w @boq/geometry && npm run build -w @boq/api && npm run build -w @boq/web
scripts.build:web: npm run templates:sync -w @boq/geometry && npm run build -w @boq/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @boq/shared && npm run build -w @boq/engine && npm run prisma:generate -w @boq/api && npm run build -w @boq/api
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @boq/shared && npm run type-check -w @boq/engine && npm run type-check -w @boq/geometry && npm run type-check -w @boq/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
